content.title: BTS Unveil Comeback Album ARIRANG
content.text: BTS have returned with their new album, ARIRANG. Stream it below, and read our review of the album here. Spanning 15 tracks, ARIRANG marks the K-pop group’s first project since the 2022 Proof compilation, and their first proper full-length since 2020’s Be. Collaborators include executive producer Diplo, Tame Impala, Mike WiLL Made-It, and JPEGMAFIA. Get BTS Tickets Here According to a press release, the album “encapsulates the identity of BTS and the universality of the emotions they encounter. Drawing from ‘Arirang,’ a traditional Korean folk song, the album symbolically reflects the group’s roots and the present-day sentiments felt by the band in 2026. Much like the timeless presence of ‘Arirang,’ the album seeks to resonate across generations and cultures, shaping an enduring legacy grounded in shared emotion.” Since the group announced its hiatus in 2022, each member completed their mandatory military service while carving out distinct solo paths. In 2022, RM shared his solo album, Indigo, while j-hope released Jack in the Box. In 2023, SUGA dropped D-DAY, V released his album Layover, Jimin shared his effort, FACE, and Jung Kook put out his solo debut, GOLDEN. Last, but not least, Jin released Happy in 2024. To support ARIRANG, BTS are set to embark on a massive world tour. Get sold-out tickets here. Additionally, the band has booked its first US late-night appearance as a full group since they completed their service in Korea. They’ll be making a stop at The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, which will first air on March 25th. Another song and performance from the visit will be broadcast the following night. To commemorate their reunion, the group is also staging a live performance, BTS The Comeback Live | Arirang, streaming March 21st on Netflix. The livestream will be the first global performance of the album, and will be broadcast from Seoul’s historic Gwanghwamun Square. It will be followed on March 27th by the release of BTS: The Return, a new documentary film chronicling the making of the band’s new album. ARIRANG Artwork: ARIRANG Tracklist: 01. Body to Body 02.
